duration.text: The Nursing at Nanjing Medical University is a 5 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4722 USD/per year ￥ 34000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3 or above 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record.

requirements.text: Finished high school studies, aged under 30 and healthy. If failed in HSK, students can attend Chinese language classes after enrollment, and begin medical studies after passing the examination. Materials Needed: 1. A photocopy of the applicant's passport; 2. Passport-size photo; 3. An official certificate of high school graduation certificate; 4. A photocopy of the transcript; 5. A photocopy of HSK certificate; 6. A photocopy of Physical Examination Form for Foreigners
